hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: Locate the middle element at index length divided by two.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Count occurrences of this central value across the entire array.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Return true if the middle value appears exactly once.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
def hasUniqueMiddleElement(nums: list[int]) -> bool:
    n = len(nums)
    if n % 2 == 0:
        return False
    mid_val = nums[n // 2]
    return nums.count(mid_val) == 1
```
